description: The family's one Renovate rule set. Every repo in renovate-global.json extends it as github>orangecheck/oc-packages:renovate-family, so a change here reaches all of them on the next run. A repo's own packageRules come after these and win.

packageRules.description: Third-party updates are off: this config tracks the @orangecheck/* family only. Every update type is listed, because a rule naming only patch, minor and major let lockFileMaintenance open third-party PRs that sat for months.

@orangecheck/* patch and minor: one PR per repo on renovate/@orangecheck-(family), one day after the publish. Renovate does not merge it (its token cannot read check runs); the repo's own CI does, in its merge-renovate job, once the gating jobs pass.
@orangecheck/* majors change wire shape: a PR of their own, labelled major-bump, merged by a person, one day after the publish.

Below 1.0 a minor can break (semver promises nothing there, and Renovate marks it breaking). It leaves the family group for a PR of its own, labelled major-bump and merged by a person, like a major. A 0.x patch stays in the family group.
